title: Causes for Enlarged Pores
headings: Other causes for enlarged pores include:
paragraphs: The pores on our skin have an essential function in the body, though they can also cause frustration when enlarged. The leading causes of enlarged pores are excessive oil production. When oil collects in the pore, the pore can become blocked when combined with dirt or makeup; it stretches the pore, making it look bigger than it is. If the pore stays clogged, a pimple may develop. While many things can cause overactive oil glands, it is most likely a genetic problem.
